description: Image Description: The image shows a small blue laptop with its screen open, positioned on a surface. The laptop has a white bezel around the screen, which is dark, indicating that it is turned off. It features a blue keyboard and two antennas extending upwards. Surrounding the laptop are several stacks of closed laptops in two colors: green on the left and blue on the right. The laptops are neatly stacked on top of each other, with the green ones forming a larger stack compared to the blue ones
